why: UNIVERSES: all universe-polymorphic theorems at 0; A = conjunction of the 81 listed theorems (15 definitions/structures are vocabulary). A => B: the main forms (theorem_16_6_6_index_zero_wellDefined_unconditional and its parts _solutionSet_noBumps, _count_eq_unconditional, _all_admissible_unconditional) assume CanonicalGermInput o 0 = tame germ data of the model F of o (IsScFredholmSectionTame) plus index 0; every other main form of A (_wellDefined, _exists, _wellDefined_all, _count_eq, _canonical, _inherited, ...) assumes CanonicalInput/CanonicalBumpInput/CanonicalInput_all/IndexZeroInput, which also carry tameness. B assumes only index 0 at smooth objects, and in the project tameness does not follow from boundary = empty (TameGermTransfer/UntamedCorner: d_X = 0 with germ data in a chart with d_C(0) = 1 need not be tame). The two statements differ by exactly this hypothesis: main_to_B_tame proves B with tameness added from the main form (plain #rt_check OK), so A => B holds for tame models and is open otherwise. B => A: B gives the existence part and the weighted-count (integral) part of the main form (B_gives_main, using HasCompactSolutionSet, which B assumes and the project form does not), but every main form of A also states equality of the effective count (the oint integral), which B does not state; and A has about 75 auxiliary ep-groupoid lemmas, alternative forms (with partitions of unity, bump functions, regular perturbations, correspondences) and worked examples that B does not state, whose proofs would need the banned lemmas. Satisfiability: CanonicalGermInput o 0 and IsCanonicalPointSolutionSet o Q are both satisfiable (OrbifoldSquare.theorem_16_6_6_hypotheses, OrbifoldSquare.exists_canonical_t5, conjuncts of A), so the main forms are not vacuous.
overlap: No direction proved, so #rt_check is run on the glue lemmas: main_to_B_tame (main form => B with tameness), B_gives_main (B => existence + integral part of the main form) and B_imp_B_tame all pass plain #rt_check. HARNESS: A's statement itself reaches the banned StrongBundleLocalizationExamples.pullOr_ofHom_z3InvHom (a direct argument of the definition z3InvCorrespondence in the type of theorem_16_6_6_index_zero_correspondence_z3), and EP.isPointTame_sub / EpFunctor.isPointTame_pullSection_of through _proof_ fields; so no term mentioning A passes #rt_check or even #rt_check_soft (recorded with #guard_msgs on A_to_B_tame). rt_overlap B_gives_main: 5470 shared project theorems, all from the statement vocabulary of B (sc-Fredholm sections, orientation representatives, PointOrientedPerturbation, IsCanonicalPointSolutionSet / solutionPointPerturbation and their proof fields); the proof itself uses only B.
